tei:div.tei:p: da lan 'dir mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di yang gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og/ nged zhib 'jug khang nas ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang legs sgrig byas pa brgyud/ dpe rgyun dkon zhing deng dus nye bar mkho ba'i rin bral gyi gsung rab khag cig ste/ gnyal ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu lta ba spyi khyab tu ngo sprod pa'i khrid yig 'di ni ma dpe se ra dgon nas g.yar gnang zhus pa dang*/ ma dpe 'di de sngon shing par du 'khod kyang da lta rmeg med du song zin 'dug /paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mdzad pa'i dge ldan bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag chen rtsa ba rgyal ba'i gzhung lam zhes bya ba dang de'i rang 'grel rgyas par bshad pa yang gsal sgron me zhes bya gnyis dang*/ byang chub lam gyi sgron ma'i rnam bshad phul byung bzhad pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bcas tshan pa gsum po 'di bkra shis lhun po dgon nas g.yar gnang zhus pa dang*/ lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i lta mgur a ma ngos 'dzin zhes bya ba shing par se ra dgon du yod/ 7gong ma chen po'i lung gis zhwa ser bstan pa'i gsal byed a chi thu no man han du 'bod pas mdzad pa/ lta ba'i nyams mgur a ma ngos 'dzin gyi 'grel pa bdag 'dzin dgra dpung 'joms pa'i mtshon cha skal ldan padmo bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di'i ma dpe bkra shis lhun po'i grwa pa zhig las g.yar gnang zhus pa bris ma yin/ gong zhus kyi gsung rab 'di rnams gdul bya rnams sems sbyong ba la nye bar mkho ba dang*/ lag tu len bde ba/ tshig gi spros pa mi rgyas par don gyi snying po rtsal du ston nas lta sgom spyod gsum gyi lam gyi gnas cha tshang la lam gyi go rim mthar chags su bsgrigs nas ston pas na nyams su len bde ba ma zad/ grub mtha' ris med kyi nyams len gyi zab gnad rnams dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab tshul lung rigs dri ma med pa gnyis kyi lam nas legs par sgrub pa'i bstan bcos tshan pa drug po 'di phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas par skrun zhus pa yin/

gzhung drug po 'dis brjod bya gang zhig bstan snyam na/ dang pos/ lta ba spyi khyab tu ngo sprod pa'i tshul dang*/ lta ba zab mo la bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir rje btsun tsong kha pa'i dgongs pa cung zad bstan pa gnyis kyis theg pa chen po'i lam rgya che ba dang*/ zab pa'i rim pa gnyis las zab mo ste lta ba'i cha gtso bor gtan la phab nas sngon byon skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig tu sgrub yod/ gnyis pa dang gsum pas/ phyag rgya chen po la bzhed tshul mang yang*/ mdo sngags gnyis su 'du la/ sngags kyi dbang du byas nas mdor bsdus tsam zhig rnam par bshad pa dang*/ mdo'i dbang du byas nas rgyas par bshad pa gnyis kyis phyag rgya chen po dang*/ dbu ma dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po gsum dgongs pa gcig tu gnas pa lung rigs dri ma med pa gnyis kyis legs par sgrub par mdzad yod/ bzhi pas/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa spyir bshad pa dang*/ bye brag so so'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'i sgo nas mngon par mtho ba lha mi'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs dang*/ nges par legs pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs ma nor bar nyams su len tshul gnyis kyis thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi lam nyams su len tshul dang bcas pas skal ldan gyi skyes bu sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par byed pa'i skyes bu mchog gi chos lugs/ skyes bu gsum gyi nyams su blang bar bya ba'i rim pa mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bsdus nas bstan yod/ lnga pa dang drug pas/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba nyams su len tshul te/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes dngos bshad pa dang*/ grub mtha' smra ba gzhan gyi 'dod pa brjod pa/ rang nyid kyi zab mo'i lta ba btsal ba'i tshul gsum gyis lam rim pa gnyis kyis rnal 'byor la brten nas 'bras bu zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed tshul gsal bar bstan yod/
